name: brand-assets
body:
Brand assets: repo-root `brand/` directory holding:
- `brand/logo_dark.svg`: dark-filled hexagon tile, for dark backgrounds.
- `brand/logo_light.svg`: light-filled hexagon tile, for light backgrounds.
- `brand/LICENSE`: all rights reserved, Really Knows AI, plus the trademark statement.
Both SVGs are split and recoloured from the logo SVG per solution.note.brand-mark-source, keeping the path geometry unchanged, using a square cropped viewBox and only `#0F1115`/`#F8F9FA`/`#FF5722`. The wordmark is plain "kalide" text in lowercase Helvetica, used in docs as documentation text rather than an asset file. The files are referenced only from README.md (which may switch between the two SVGs via `<picture>`/`prefers-color-scheme`), package-channel descriptions and an optional GitHub social preview. They are repository/documentation collateral under `brand/`, keeping the binary, its embedded core and the served page shells brand-free (global.constraint.core-unbranded, global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets), and `brand/` sits outside the root Apache-2.0 LICENSE under its own all-rights-reserved `brand/LICENSE` (requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded).
